English.Char_Desc_2000:
SWEEPR Deepblock v1.4.0 at https://sweeprdeepblock.com is a proprietary Manifest V3 ad, tracker, and cookie consent blocker built for Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, Apple Safari (macOS & iOS), and Mozilla Firefox (Gecko 128.0+ Desktop & Android).
Key Features: 1. No-Card 7-Day Full Pro Trial: Starts immediately on install without a credit card or license key; Pro modules gate automatically after 7 days unless upgraded. 2. Video & Banner Ad Shield: Blocks pre-roll and mid-roll video ads on YouTube, Twitch, and streaming sites using 36,019 static declarativeNetRequest rules across 5 rulesets + 100 dynamic OTA rules while passing all 8 anti-adblock checks verified live at https://sweeprdeepblock.com/test-lab 3. Automatic Cookie Pop-Up Closer & Scroll Unlock: Automatically clicks "Reject All" or "Necessary Only" across 160 GDPR cookie banner frameworks while keeping page scrolling unlocked. 4. Private, Tracker-Free Browsing (229 Parameters): Strips 229 hidden tracking codes (utm_, fbclid, gclid, msclkid, twclid, ttclid, etc.) from URLs. 5. Element Zapper & Total Tab & RAM Tamer: Removes page clutter on demand and hibernates inactive background tabs to reduce browser memory usage. 6. Transparent Pricing: No-card 7-day full Pro trial, £1.99 1st-Month Intro, £29.99/yr Pro Annual (5 devices), or £89.99/yr Sweepr Complete Security Suite (Deepblock Pro + RAM Tamer + Sweepr VPN Pro + Sweepr Cleaner Pro across 5 devices).
